csm_omar: Heads-up — Meridian Day‑Zero is in 7 days. Need a runnable capacity handoff: quota priming steps, autoscale thresholds, a short enablement script for their ops, and a note capturing renewal risk for the CSM deck. Can we reconcile today? :spiral_calendar:
eng_lin: What are their target QPS and P95 SLOs? Also any gen-model fallbacks they'd accept?
sean_sales: Meridian flagged latency sensitivity at high concurrencies. Renewal review in 45 days — we should capture any SLA gaps. They want p95 <= 450ms on chat route, target steady QPS 600 with spikes to 1500.
ops_zoe: Pool we proposed: 4 x H100-80 reserved in eu-west-1. Warm priming currently ~6m for 4 nodes. If we need <20s cold-start, we must keep at least 1 warm replica per shard.
devex_anya: Suggest we run a headless load job with telemetry export to observability. Example job:
```
locust -f tests/meridian_locust.py --headless -u 800 -r 60 --run-time 18m --host https://api.redwood.internal \ 
  --header "X-Test-Mode: true" --env telemetry_export=true
```
Also add a short ops script to validate KMS access: `scripts/validate_kms.sh`
eng_lin: Autoscale proposal (posting here, will PR to infra):
```
{"min_replicas":"1","max_replicas":"6","scale_rps_target":750,"scale_cpu_target":55,"cooldown_seconds":60,"burst_threshold_rps":1200,"burst_duration_s":60,"fallback_model":"quant-small-2"}
```
If sustained RPS>1400 for 2m then switch to burst pool and notify on-call.
ops_zoe: I'll pre-provision burst pool and create a priming job. Plan: staggered priming per shard `for i in 1..4` sleep 60; run prime set. This reduces thundering herd.
infra-bot: Created ticket Q-5542 (quota: meridian-reserved-eu-west-1). Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/Q-5542
csm_omar: Good. Sean, I'll add a short renewal-risk blurb summarizing p95 gap and proposed mitigations. DevEx, can you assemble a 10‑minute ops runbook we can send to Meridian?
devex_anya: On it — will drop a 1‑page OpsChecklist + canary playbook here. Canary sequence I recommend: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% over 20m. Rollback triggers: p95 > 600ms OR error_rate > 0.8% over sliding 2m window. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-day0-handoff
ops_zoe: Heads-up — there is a DB migration scheduled in eu-west-1 Fri 22:30 UTC that might interfere with the dry-run. Can we move the dry-run window earlier or push the migration?
csm_omar: Let's avoid overlap. Proposed dry-run: Fri 20:00-22:00 UTC pre-check at 19:30 UTC. If migration can't move, shift to Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. Sean, can you confirm Meridian ops preference?
sean_sales: Meridian prefers Fri evening. I'll nudge them to accept 19:30 pre-check.
eng_lin: I'll open the autoscale PR and attach canary config. ETA 45m.
ops_zoe: Priming job scheduled, provisioning burst pool started. ETA ~50m. I'll post logs and a small sample of prime-curl outputs when done.
infra-bot: Alert: quota ticket Q-5542 updated by ops_zoe. Status: pending-provision.
csm_omar: Final quick checklist for this thread — copy to our onboarding doc and Meridian sheet:
1) autoscale JSON (eng_lin)
2) priming & burst pool (ops_zoe)
3) locust job + ops checklist (devex_anya)
4) renewal-risk note + customer message (csm_omar)
Please mark when done. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
eng_lin: marked — autoscale PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/meridian-autoscale/pull/12
ops_zoe: provisioning done, logs uploaded to https://storage.redwood.internal/priming/meridian/logs.txt
devex_anya: ops checklist + canary updated in playbooks and copied to Meridian folder.
csm_omar: Thanks all — will draft renewal note and send to exec for the 45d review. Back here with confirmation after pre-check.
